ZEST

Packaging2026

A citrus range built to read as a family on shelf.

STATUS
Self-initiated concept
ROLE
Art direction, design and production study
OUTPUT
Editable vector layouts / PDF

CONTEXT / PROBLEM

Three flavours need to remain recognisable together without making shoppers search for the variant.

Creative direction

A heavy wordmark leads. Fruit geometry and flavour colour do the secondary work.

The system

Front labels, flavour family, wrap proof, information panel and shelf campaign.

PRODUCTION / DELIVERY

Made to be used again.

Editable label artwork. Supplier-approved dielines and verified regulatory text remain required.

Design outcome

The finished study demonstrates a repeatable design system and production-aware decisions. No measured business result is claimed.
